content:
morgan: heads-up — planning a non-urgent kernel/runtime push + quant profile swap into canary tomorrow 07:30 PST. target image runtime:v2.14-quantQ3. canary window 07:30-08:30 PST. need: smoke owner, rollback owner, metrics reviewer. callouts: kv-cache bump + model-compat quick test.

devon: i can own smoke checks. will run the prompt sanity set and perf smoke (latency vs baseline).

riley: i'll be rollback owner. know the rollback steps and have the previous image pinned.

jade: i'll watch dashboards and traces. can we set an automated traffic shift: 5% start -> 20% after 15m if no errors?

morgan: yes — plan is 5% for 15m then 20% for another 15m, then stop or expand based on signal. if any error rate >0.5% or p95 increase >40% -> immediate rollback.

lee: quick Q — does quantQ3 change kv-cache layout? do we need to flush caches?

anya: quantQ3 updates numeric packing only, no KV schema changes. still, i recommend a small cache invalidation on canary nodes to avoid stale prefixes. add step in smoke: `curl -X POST $ADMIN/cache/invalidate?prefix=kv`

morgan: good catch. add to smoke checklist: run kv invalidate, verify no prefix errors in logs.

devon: smoke checklist draft:
- deploy to canary slot canary-3
- run `kv invalidate`
- run prompt sanity (5 short prompts) against canary
- check p50/p95 latency (dash link below)
- check error rate and 50x/5xx logs
- confirm no model-output regressions via quick eval (eval harness)

riley: rollback steps for quick reference:
1) `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.13 -n inference`
2) revert canary traffic routing (route control) -> 0%
3) drain canary nodes and redeploy baseline if needed
4) open incident if rollback triggered and collect traces

morgan: adding monitoring endpoints:
- metrics: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/runtime/canary
- logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/query?env=canary
- alert runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime-canary

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job 1794506795 queued by @morgan for canary-3 at 07:30 PST. job id: job-9932.

devon: i'll kick off smoke run at +2 min after deploy.

jade: oncall this window is @lee — tagging for visibility. lee can you ack?

lee: ack. i'll be online 07:15-08:45 PST. ping me for manual rollback if thresholds hit.

anya: note: quant profile artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/quantQ3/sha-abc123. load test locally first? small vector of prompts matched to high-token cases.

morgan: timeline + owners summarized:
- 07:15 PST: preflight check (morgan)
- 07:30 PST: deploy to canary-3 (deploy-bot)
- 07:32 PST: smoke run (devon) -> kv invalidate, sanity prompts, quick eval
- 07:35-07:50 PST: monitoring and metric ramp (jade + lee watching)
- 07:50 PST: decision point to expand or abort (morgan + lee + riley)
- rollback owner riley ready to execute if signals breach

morgan: anything else? if no blockers i'll schedule the job now and post final timeline in #eng-runtime 1h before window.

riley: one more ask — if rollback happens, keep canary pod logs for at least 2 hours (we need them for regression triage).

jade: noted. will ensure log retention and take a trace snapshot if we hit p95 spikes.

devon: looks good. :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks team. posting final confirmation in ~45m unless someone objects.

ops-bot: reminder — please attach the runbook link to the deploy job metadata to make postmortem collection easier.
